integrity: The universal theorem has a self-contained valuation-layer proof and a standalone supplementary 16-case modular elimination test. Some special-case rank/dual/hull facts are explicitly credited to earlier literature. The stated row-code distance-one result is supported by an explicit row combination; novelty searches cannot prove worldwide uniqueness.
scientific_limitations: Finite commutative chain rings of nilpotency length at least three; loopless ordinary zero-divisor adjacency row code over the prime residue characteristic. This is not an incidence or Laplacian code and makes no claim of positive primal error-correction distance beyond one.
title: Modular adjacency codes of finite chain rings: exact kernels and weight-one socle words
